issues.description: The Stock.getStockIngredients method has different return types in the template and the solution. In the template it returns java.util.List<StockIngredient>, while in the solution it returns StockIngredient[]. This discrepancy is not clarified in the problem statement and can confuse students about which API to use when interacting with Stock.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type of Stock.getStockIngredients consistent across template and solution and document it in the problem statement. Either (A) change the template method to return StockIngredient[] to match the solution, or (B) change the solution to return List<StockIngredient>. Also update the problem statement/UML to explicitly state the chosen return type so students know which API to implement.
